$doc: Which release-please, and which @conventional-commits/parser, the pinned release-please-action bundles. Measured from the action's own lockfile: gh api 'repos/googleapis/release-please-action/contents/package-lock.json?ref=<actionSha>' --jq .content | base64 -d, then read BOTH packages['node_modules/release-please'].version and packages['node_modules/@conventional-commits/parser'].version. ReleaseParserVersionPinTests reds when release-please.yml's action SHA stops matching actionSha. RE-MEASURE on every bump; do not just copy the new SHA in.
